purpose: Diagnose whether adaptive rank allocation adds value after review of terminal refusal-boundary failures; engineering/public-development pilot only.
required_preconditions: Independent reviewers complete and adjudicate the blind review packet.
Any changed labels are independently approved and the new public dataset manifest is frozen.
A v4 worker and artifact validator bind numerical_metric_policy_v2, per-update learning rates, class/family support, checkpoint metrics, and exact worker identity.
The new worker passes local adversarial, deterministic numerical, artifact-replay, allocation-timing, and version-substitution tests.
A new signed admission and durable budget are issued by the authorized controller; prior budgets are not reused.

arms.allocation: fixed predeclared mask; no adaptive reallocation

design.starting_point: Within each seed, clone the same frozen ModernBERT weights and classifier head for every arm.
design.data_and_order: Same reviewed public training records, frozen split, sampler seed, batch order, and exposure count for all arms.
design.optimizer: AdamW; preserve admitted 0.0003 adapter and head rates for the first matched comparison; no scheduler or other one-factor change.
design.checkpoint_policy: Keep initial, best-public-development, and terminal checkpoints. Do not use regression data for selection.
telemetry: actual optimizer-group learning rates after every update

screening_rules_to_preregister.primary_public_endpoint: mean complete-counterfactual-pair improvement of AdaLoRA-12-to-8 over fixed-r8 at least 0.05 across the three registered seeds
screening_rules_to_preregister.mechanism_check: Compare AdaLoRA-12-to-8 against AdaLoRA-static-r8; if there is no consistent pair-performance advantage, do not attribute gains to adaptive allocation.
guardrails: No per-seed worst-family regression versus fixed-r8.
No increase in REFUSE-to-CHEAP/FAST or ASK-to-CHEAP/FAST proposals versus fixed-r8.
Preserve all seeds and failures; do not select a seed after observing results.
screening_rules_to_preregister.interpretation: Three-seed public screening only; no significance, independent generalization, qualification, or deployment claim. A later confirmatory study needs a separate protocol and admission.
